description: Places a price someone pays or was quoted among the prices on record. For a model API: where it stands against the official list price, the lowest recorded channel and the batch price. For a GPU: how many providers' on-demand list prices it undercuts, and the spot, reserved and marketplace prices. Use it for "is $X a good price for Y". Nothing is stored.

currency.description: gpu only; CNY compares with mainland China prices

item.description: Model id or alias (token), or GPU id such as h100 (gpu)

output_price.description: token only: output price in USD per 1M tokens

price.description: token: input price in USD per 1M tokens; gpu: price per GPU-hour

name: check_price
title: Is this price fair?
